faqs.question: How much do you charge?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the scope and complexity of the project. For an accurate quote, email him at mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com with your project details and requirements.

faqs.question: What is your development process?
faqs.answer:
His process is simple and effective:

1. Understand the requirements and goals
2. Design the structure and user experience
3. Build with clean, maintainable code
4. Test, optimize for performance and accessibility
5. Deploy and support
keywords: how does he work on projects

faqs.question: What kind of websites do you build?
faqs.answer: He builds landing pages, business websites, portfolios, e-commerce stores, dashboards, web tools, blogs and full web applications — anything that runs in the browser.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: A landing page typically takes 1–2 weeks, a business website 2–4 weeks, and a full web application 4–8 weeks depending on scope. Timelines are agreed upfront before work starts.
keywords: how long does a project take

faqs.question: Do you offer revisions?
faqs.answer: Yes — revisions are included to make sure the final result matches your expectations. The number of revisions depends on the project scope and is agreed before starting.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes — he provides a support period after launch for bug fixes and small adjustments, and can offer ongoing maintenance plans for larger projects.

faqs.question: How do payments work?
faqs.answer: Payment terms are agreed per project — typically a deposit before starting and the remainder on delivery. He can work with the payment methods that suit your region.

faqs.question: Do you sign contracts?
faqs.answer: Yes — he's happy to work with a simple written agreement or contract covering scope, timeline and payment, so both sides know exactly what to expect.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes — he can redesign or rebuild existing websites: modernize the design, improve performance, fix responsiveness, upgrade the stack or migrate to a new platform.

faqs.question: Do you offer maintenance plans?
faqs.answer: Yes — he offers ongoing maintenance: content updates, bug fixes, performance monitoring and small feature improvements on a monthly or per-project basis.

faqs.question: Do you offer frontend-only work?
faqs.answer: Yes — he takes frontend-only projects: building responsive interfaces, design implementation, animations and frontend performance optimization with HTML, CSS, TypeScript and React.

faqs.question: Do you offer backend-only work?
faqs.answer: Yes — he takes backend projects: REST API development, server architecture, authentication, integrations and database design with Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

faqs.question: Can you build me an e-commerce website?
faqs.answer: Yes — e-commerce is one of his specialties. His Furnecher project proves it: a complete storefront with catalog, product pages and checkout flow, built with React, Node.js and MongoDB.

faqs.question: Can you build me a business website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — business websites, landing pages and portfolios are his bread and butter: fast, SEO-friendly, responsive and built to convert visitors into customers.

faqs.question: Which technologies do you use for client projects?
faqs.answer: For client projects he uses his proven stack: TypeScript, React, HTML5 and CSS3 on the frontend; Node.js, Express and MongoDB on the backend; deployed on Vercel or similar platforms.

faqs.question: How do you communicate during a project?
faqs.answer: He communicates via email, WhatsApp and video calls. You get regular progress updates, milestone reviews and honest status reporting — no surprises.

faqs.question: Can you handle rush projects?
faqs.answer: He can handle short timelines for small projects when his schedule allows — message him early at mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com and he'll tell you honestly what's possible.

faqs.question: Is the quote free?
faqs.answer: Yes — project quotes and initial consultations are completely free. Email mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com with your idea and he'll respond with an estimate.

faqs.question: Can you help me build a portfolio?
faqs.answer: Yes — personal portfolios are a specialty! He builds premium portfolios like this one, with SEO, performance and even an AI assistant if you want one.

faqs.question: Do you build dashboards?
faqs.answer: Yes — admin dashboards, analytics panels and data visualization interfaces with clean layouts, charts and real-time data.

faqs.question: Can you build an API for my project?
faqs.answer: Yes — he designs and builds REST APIs with Node.js, Express and TypeScript: clean routes, validation, authentication and documentation.

faqs.question: Can you help startups?
faqs.answer: Yes — he loves working with startups and founders: MVPs, landing pages and early product iterations, built fast with clean engineering foundations.

faqs.question: Do you work with no-code tools?
faqs.answer: He focuses on custom code development — that's where he adds the most value. If your project fits a no-code tool better, he'll tell you honestly and point you in the right direction.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes — he works with clients worldwide in English, across all time zones, using email, WhatsApp and video calls for communication.

faqs.question: What information do you need to start?
faqs.answer: To start, share: the type of website or app you want, its goals, examples you like, your timeline and your budget range. That's enough for a free quote.
keywords: what do you need from me
